title: Drain Myth: Chemical Cleaners Cure All
description: A common misconception in plumbing is that chemical drain cleaners are a universal fix for slow or clogged drainage systems. In reality, harsh caustic chemicals can damage older piping materials, fail to completely remove stubborn obstructions, and pose severe safety hazards to service technicians working on the line. Professional diagnosis relies on proper mechanical clearing, such as snaking or hydro-jetting, combined with visual inspection to identify the root cause of the restriction rather than masking it with a temporary chemical solution.

Drain Myth: Chemical Cleaners Cure All

A common misconception in plumbing is that chemical drain cleaners are a universal fix for slow or clogged drainage systems. In reality, harsh caustic chemicals can damage older piping materials, fail to completely remove stubborn obstructions, and pose severe safety hazards to service technicians working on the line. Professional diagnosis relies on proper mechanical clearing, such as snaking or hydro-jetting, combined with visual inspection to identify the root cause of the restriction rather than masking it with a temporary chemical solution.
